Quests.Title: The Worship
Quests.Story: Have a seat, adventurer, and hear me tell the tale of Atlantis. Thousands of years ago, this was a beauteous and bountiful land, blessed by Poseidon himself. However, as our royal family began to fall into vice and depravity, Poseidon was enraged and sank the entire Atlantis into the deepest depths of the sea. Together with 3 other Mages, we have decided to stay and watch over the last temple of Poseidon for the rest of our lives. In return, Atlantian people got to keep this small stretch of land and preserve our bloodlines. However the Sea Serpents have invaded our temple and we no longer could worship the almighty Poseidon with the precious stones! Please, enter the 2nd level of the temple and help me get the stones back from Manad, Arod and Carlt!

We do not know where these wonderful and gentle beings came from, but ever since they came to our land, they became great friends of ours. Sadly, with the invasion of evil monsters in the temple, some Unicorns have been captured as well. Moreover, the heinous magic of the monsters have led the imprisoned Unicorns to lose their sanity and kindness, turning them into killing machines. Quests.Title: The Kind Indian Princess
Quests.Story: I caught hold of a suspicious girl and demanded to know why she was lurking around. The girl calmly told me that her name is Sana and that she is maid to Princess Pocahontas. She told me an amazing story. When John Smith was captured by Chief Powhatan of Tsenacommacah and was about to be beheaded, the chief's daughter, Pocahontas, saved John Smith's life by placing herself between him and the axe wielder. She then helped John Smith to escape. But now the princess has been kidnapped and Sana feels that John Smith is the only one who can save the princess.
Quests.Objective: Listen to Sana's account of the story of Princess Pocahontas and John Smith. (Complete the quest by talking to Sana)

Back then, sushi was a fish preservation method that originated from Japan and involved coating fish with salt, followed by flattening and natural fermentation. Quests.Title: Collecting Ginseng [lower]
Quests.Story: The wilderness here is rich in treasures, and explorers often suffer from not having enough bags to carry them. For me,among all the products, ginseng is my favorite. The aristocrats and wealthy merchants of the Old World regarded this magical plant as a treasure. Wild ginseng can be found everywhere in the wilderness outside the camp, and you can easily gather them, as well as examine the geography of the area in the process! Ginseng [lower] can be collected in the wilderness outside the camp, or you can get it through planting. Tip: Ginseng seeds [lower] can be collected in the wilderness, medium grade and above ginseng seeds need to be obtained through planting, guild members can get the Growing Base Resource Kit from the grocer in the camp, go to the wilderness outside the camp and look for a piece of land that can be cultivated If you want to plant crops, you can place the Resource Kit and then you can cultivate the crops around it. When planting crops, you have to kill the foraging animals that affect the growth of crops in a timely manner, and adding dung balls or fertilizers to the planting base can accelerate the growth of crops.
Quests.Objective: Collecting ginseng [lower], and give him to the camp's Adventurer Alliance Mission Officer.

Reward.Text: Adventure Proof of Desire World (Primary)*30 Adventure Proof of Desire World (Premium)*5

Quests.Title: Collecting Canned [lower]
Quests.Story: In this area food spoils so easily that explorers often had to interrupt their expeditions because of food problems. It was discovered that by placing those freshly meats into fermenting barrels, they could be made into canned food and thus preserved for long periods of time. This method of storing meat had not yet been practiced in Europe! Canned [lower] needs to be obtained through fermentation Tip: Purchase [Fermentation Barrels] from the grocer in the camp, go to the campsite's Fermenter Administrator to report the placement of the barrels, open the barrels, put in the fermentation main material (necessary) and the auxiliary ingredient, click on Start Fermentation, and wait for the fermentation to complete Meat of various qualities (Desire World animals drop after death) is the main material for fermentation, the higher the quality the better the fermentation effect. The spices collected in the wild can be used as auxiliary materials for fermentation, but exactly which spices are adapted to which kind of meat is not yet known, it can only be confirmed that high-quality Reishi (collected or cultivated in the caves) has a facilitating effect on the fermentation of all meats!
Quests.Objective: Collect some Canned [lower] and give them to the camp's Adventurer Alliance Mission Officer

Quests.Title: Collecting White Diamond of Desire
Quests.Story: According to the guidance of an ancient handbook, the explorers find a portal deep in the desert to the City of Desire, a city that has faded from the world, where there is not a single person to be seen, but all kinds of treasure chests are scattered all over the city. Open those chests and bring back the treasures inside, it's as simple as that! White Diamond of Desire are available in the Treasure Chest of the City of Desire Tip: Wilderness -> Cave -> Desert -> City of Desire, the path is not peaceful, it is best to go in teams. The ancient portal in and out of the City of Desire is open for a limited time, and there are only a limited number of people who can enter each time, so good luck!
Quests.Objective: Go to the City of Desire and collect the White Diamond of Desire, then give them to the Warrior Alliance Mission Officer at the camp.

Quests.Title: Collecting Beast Teeth
Quests.Story: There is still a long way to go before fully occupying this world, and the population of beasts here is so powerful that the camp can't organize enough men to clear them out. Finish them off and you'll be rewarded handsomely. Of course you'll have to bring back something to prove you killed them, like pulling off hardened teeth. Don't think it's cruel, realize that if they kill us, even the bones will be chewed. Kill common individuals in the Beast Population to get Beast Teeth Tips: Open the map to view the populations' habitats in the various scenes outside the camp. Please note that Beast Kings and Elite Beasts also grow gradually from common animals, do not kill those individuals with potential too early. There is only one Beast King and a number of Elite Beasts in a population, and other low-level beasts grow up after they die.
Quests.Objective: Go out into the wilderness and collect the Beast Teeth, then give them to the Warrior Alliance Mission Officer at the camp.

Quests.Title: Collecting Blood Diamond of Desire
Quests.Story: One of the world's most mysterious and rare diamonds, many people say that every Blood Diamond of Desire is dripping with blood. In fact, it's not like that, I have had the honor of seeing it once. Bright red and rounded, without the edges of ordinary diamonds. There are only a few clues on how to get this diamond, only that you can get it from the treasure chests in the City of Desire, which will show you how to get it. Find the Treasure Chest in the City of Desire and look for the 'Barbarous Signet' for more clues on how to get the Blood Diamond of Desire.
Quests.Objective: Collect the Blood Diamond of Desire and give them to the Camp Leader.

Quests.Title: Collecting Desire Deliciousness
Quests.Story: As the leader of the camp, I was fortunate enough to taste this delicious food. It is a fermented food, but ordinary fermentation barrels in the campsite cannot ferment it. The fermentation of this food requires a special environment The earliest inhabitants of this continent lived in caves, and the fermentation barrels left behind can make this delicious food. Go to the caves to look for broken fermentation barrels to see if they can be made into this delicacy Hint: The gloomy caves are full of disgusting animals, the fermentation barrels that are about to rot are unmanaged, and anyone can open them after the fermentation is complete, so once you use them for fermentation, look after them carefully.
Quests.Objective: Collect Desire Deliciousness and give them to theCamp Leader.

Quests.Title: Desire World Expedition Oath
Quests.Story: The world that human beings know is extremely limited, when we think that the unknown world only exists in the corner, in fact, in the corner of the world is exactly our own. Distant places do not summon us, summoning comes from the depths of our hearts, and the surging desire in our blood constantly leads people on new journeys.Are you ready, young captain? The camp leader of Desire World will issue a series of quests for you, and upon completion, you will be awarded the Desire World Gold/Silver Medal.
Quests.Objective: Enter the Desire World, find the camp leader in the camp, and complete the quest he gives you!
